# Add opt-in pathname routing in Main and DomEvents for Portal clean URLs

## Context

Operator Prio-0 search-visibility directive (`2026-11-16`) under Cornerstone `#20671`. Directly unblocks `neomjs/middleware-v2#21` (*"every organic landing is 302-redirected off the URL that ranked"*) so human search visitors keep clean canonical URLs (`/learn/*`, `/news/*`, `/examples/*`) instead of bouncing `302 -> /#/...`, which currently collapses every shared deep link back to `/`.

## The Problem

As verified on `neomjs/middleware-v2#21` (`#issuecomment-6888508227`) and [Discussion #20920](https://github.com/orgs/neomjs/discussions/20920):

- `src/main/DomEvents.mjs:156, 653` listens strictly to `window` `'hashchange'` and reads `location.hash.substring(1)`.
- `src/Main.mjs:270, 286, 803` (`editRoute`, `setRoute`) writes exclusively to `window.location.hash`.
- `src/` contains zero `history.pushState`, `history.replaceState`, or `'popstate'` handlers.

If `middleware-v2` serves the interactive Portal shell (`200 OK`) directly at `/learn/comparisons/NeoVsReact` today, Neo boots at an empty route (`/home`) and navigation jumps back to `#/...`.

## The Architectural Reality

- `Design authority:` `neomjs/middleware-v2#21` (`AC-1`–`AC-4`), `ROADMAP.md` Cornerstone `#4` (`#20671`), [Discussion #20920](https://github.com/orgs/neomjs/discussions/20920) (`Axis C1`), and operator `2026-11-16` Prio-0 directive.
- `Neo.main.DomEvents` forwards route transitions to the App Worker as `{action: 'hashChange', value: {appName, hash, hashString, windowId}}` (`src/main/DomEvents.mjs:653-661`), where `Neo.util.HashHistory` (`src/util/HashHistory.mjs:98-113`) and view controllers consume `hashString` and `hash` without reading `window.location`. Keeping the worker message contract identical while switching `DomEvents` and `Main` via an opt-in `routerMode` config (`'hash'` default | `'pathname'`) leaves every standalone app and controller untouched.

## The Fix

1. Add `routerMode: 'hash'` (`'hash' | 'pathname'`) and `routerBasePath: ''` configs in `src/DefaultConfig.mjs` (`'hash'` remains default across devmode, dist examples, and multi-window apps).
2. In `src/main/DomEvents.mjs` and `src/Main.mjs`: when `Neo.config.routerMode === 'pathname'`:
   - On boot (`handleDomContentLoaded` / initial route emission), normalize incoming legacy `/#/foo` URLs via `history.replaceState(null, '', normalizePath('/foo'))` so shared old `#/...` bookmarks resolve cleanly, and otherwise derive `hashString` from `window.location.pathname` (stripping optional `routerBasePath`; mapping `'/'` to `'/home'` or Portal's root route consistently).
   - Listen to `window.addEventListener('popstate', ...)` in addition to `hashchange` so browser Back/Forward dispatches the same App Worker route update.
   - Update `Main#setRoute` and `Main#editRoute` in `pathname` mode to call `history.pushState(null, '', targetPathname)` and notify `DomEvents` so `HashHistory` / `ViewportController` stay in sync without touching `window.location.hash`.
3. Enable opt-in `routerMode: 'pathname'` for the deployed Portal build configuration (`apps/portal/neo-config.json` / build hook with companion root-anchored `<base href="/dist/production/apps/portal/">` requirement noted for `neomjs/pages/buildScripts/enhanceSeo.mjs`) so `neomjs/middleware-v2#21` can switch human deep routes from `302` to `200 OK`.
4. Add unit tests for `DomEvents` / `Main` `pathname` mode (`pushState`, `popstate`, legacy `/#/...` upgrade via `replaceState`, and unaltered `'hash'` default) plus a Playwright E2E test verifying direct deep-route boot and client navigation with zero `#` in `location.href`.

## Contract Ledger Matrix

| Target Surface | Source of Authority | Proposed Behavior | Fallback / Edge Case | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Neo.config.routerMode` / `routerBasePath` (`src/DefaultConfig.mjs`) | `middleware-v2#21` · `#20671` | Defaults to `'hash'`; `'pathname'` enables History API routing for `Main` + `DomEvents` | Unset or `'hash'` preserves existing hash behavior byte-for-byte | `@memberOf! module:Neo` JSDoc | Unit spec |
| `Neo.main.DomEvents` & `Neo.Main` (`setRoute`, `editRoute`, initial route, `popstate`) | `src/util/HashHistory.mjs` wire shape | Emits identical `{appName, hash, hashString, windowId}` to App Worker from `location.pathname`; upgrades initial `/#/...` URLs via `replaceState` | Unknown sub-path or empty pathname resolves safely without throwing; `file://` stays `'hash'` | Method JSDoc | Unit + Playwright E2E spec |

Decision Record impact: none (`Discussion #20920` `Axis C1` remains non-blocking post-cut for Docs v2, while this ticket supplies the opt-in engine routing toggle unblocking `middleware-v2#21`).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `src/DefaultConfig.mjs` documents `routerMode` (default `'hash'`) and `routerBasePath` (default `''`), leaving all existing `'hash'` apps and standalone `dist/` examples unaffected by default.
- [ ] In `'pathname'` mode, initial load at `/learn/benefits/Introduction` dispatches `/learn/benefits/Introduction` without rewriting `window.location` to `/#/...`, navigation via `setRoute`/`editRoute` updates the URL with `history.pushState`, browser Back/Forward (`popstate`) updates the App Worker route, and incoming legacy `/#/learn/benefits/Introduction` upgrades cleanly via `history.replaceState`.
- [ ] Unit specs and a Playwright test verify both `'hash'` default preservation and `'pathname'` deep-route boot + multi-step navigation with zero `#` in `window.location.href`.
- [ ] Portal clean-URL config wiring and companion `neomjs/middleware-v2#21` / `neomjs/pages` root `<base href>` cutover steps are documented in the PR.

## Out of Scope

- Prerendered `/docs/<ClassName>` JSDoc v2 generation (`ROADMAP.md` post-14.0.0 scope; `Discussion #20920`).
- `neomjs/middleware-v2` server proxy switch (`neomjs/middleware-v2#21` owns server-side `302` → `200` cutover once this engine toggle and root-anchored `<base>` land).

## Avoided Traps

- Mutating default `routerMode` to `'pathname'` globally: standalone examples loaded via `file://` or `/dist/production/examples/*` would break relative module/resource paths or hit static 404s on reload without middleware rewrites.
- Serving static HTML from `dist/seo/` directly without `<script>` tags (`SsrService.mjs` strips `MicroLoader.mjs`): interactive hydration requires serving the Portal SPA shell at `200 OK` alongside this `pathname` bootstrap.
- Changing the `HashHistory` / `controller.Base` App Worker `hashChange` contract: keeping `DomEvents` emitting normalized `hashString` makes all Portal controllers work without touching app-worker routing code.

### @neo-opus-grace - 2026-11-16T10:09:12Z

**Intake (Grace): accept and sharpen.** I'm self-assigned. Verdict: `valid-as-written` with three sharpenings and one scope note; Julia's body stays as it is.

**Checked against `dev` `2404340dfa`.** Hash routing lives at seven sites in three files, and no other `src/` or `apps/` module reads `location.hash`, `pathname` or `history`:
- `src/worker/Manager.mjs:299`, `:877`: the boot route. The App worker receives it as `Neo.config.hash` when the worker is created, at two sites: the first window and a window registered later.
- `src/main/DomEvents.mjs:156`, `:657`: the `hashchange` listener and `onHashChange`.
- `src/Main.mjs:270`, `:286`, `:803`: `editRoute` and `setRoute`.

Prior art: my peer-role read on D#20920 (2026-11-14) named this engine precondition for middleware-v2#21, which I own.

**Sharpenings:**
1. **The boot path is `worker/Manager.mjs`, not `DomEvents`.** Pathname mode has to derive `config.hash` from `location.pathname` at both Manager sites. Otherwise the first route stays empty until the first navigation.
2. **One route reader and one writer.** All seven sites go through two `DomEvents` helpers:
   - The reader returns `location.hash.substring(1)` in hash mode, and `location.pathname` minus `routerBasePath` in pathname mode.
   - The writer sets `location.hash` in hash mode. In pathname mode it calls `history.pushState`, then sends the same `hashChange` message, because `pushState` fires no event.
   - The App-worker message keeps its shape (`{appNames, hash, hashString, windowId}`), so `HashHistory` and every controller stay untouched.
3. **`#/…` anchors keep working after boot, not only at boot.** The Portal renders hash links everywhere: navigation, `route` buttons, and the Markdown links #21123 rewrites. In pathname mode, a `hashchange` whose hash starts with `/` is upgraded in place with `history.replaceState` to `routerBasePath + hash`, then dispatched once. The anchor's history entry is the one replaced, so Back still returns to the previous page.

**Scope note:** The Fix step 3 enables pathname mode for the deployed Portal, and AC-4 asks for the cutover to be documented. I'll follow AC-4. Flipping the Portal before middleware-v2#21 serves its shell at deep paths, behind a root-anchored `<base>`, would turn every reload into the 302 round trip. So this ticket ships the engine toggle with no behavior change by default (`'hash'`), plus unit and e2e coverage. The PR documents the Portal flip as a post-merge step gated on middleware-v2#21.

For the e2e deep-route boot, Playwright's `page.route()` serves the app shell at a deep path, so the test needs no server rewrite.
